title: Business Analytics Dashboard Metrics
description: Structured metrics extracted from a Metabase BI dashboard

total_revenue.description: Sum of total_amount for all completed orders, rounded to 2 decimal places

average_order_value.description: Average total_amount for completed orders, rounded to 2 decimal places

revenue_by_category.description: Revenue sum per product category for completed orders. Keys are category names, values are rounded to 2 decimal places.

monthly_revenue.description: Revenue sum per month for completed orders. Keys are YYYY-MM format, values rounded to 2 decimal places.

top_10_customers.description: Top 10 customers by lifetime_value, sorted descending.

orders_by_device.description: Count of completed orders per device type (desktop, mobile, tablet).

orders_by_channel.description: Count of completed orders per acquisition channel.

event_funnel.description: Count of events per event_type (page_view, product_view, add_to_cart, checkout_start, purchase).

conversion_rate.description: Percentage: (purchase events / page_view events) * 100, rounded to 2 decimal places

unique_purchasing_customers.description: Count of distinct customer_ids with at least one completed order
